name: Everest Base Camp
summary: The classic walk into the heart of the Khumbu — through Sherpa villages and rhododendron forest, beneath the walls of Ama Dablam, to stand at the foot of the highest mountain on Earth.
highlights: Stand at Everest Base Camp beneath the Khumbu Icefall
Sunrise over Everest from Kala Patthar (5,545m)
Tengboche Monastery, spiritual center of the Khumbu
Namche Bazaar — bakeries, markets and mountain museums
Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site

itinerary.title: Fly to Lukla, trek to Phakding
itinerary.description: A thrilling mountain flight onto Lukla's short runway, then an easy walk down the Dudh Koshi valley to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Phakding to Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Cross swaying suspension bridges draped in prayer flags, then climb the long forested hill to the Sherpa capital.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Namche
itinerary.description: Hike to the Everest View Hotel for your first sight of Everest, Lhotse and Ama Dablam, then rest and explore town.

itinerary.title: Namche to Tengboche
itinerary.description: Contouring ridgelines with huge views, a descent through rhododendron forest, and a final climb to Tengboche's famous monastery.

itinerary.title: Tengboche to Dingboche
itinerary.description: Leave the treeline behind as the valley opens into stark glacial terrain beneath Island Peak.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Dingboche
itinerary.description: Optional climb of Nangkartshang Hill for views of Makalu, the world's fifth highest mountain.

itinerary.title: Dingboche to Lobuche
itinerary.description: Climb the terminal moraine past the moving memorials to fallen climbers at Thukla Pass.

itinerary.title: Everest Base Camp
itinerary.description: Walk the Khumbu glacier to Base Camp itself — prayer flags, ice towers, and the notorious icefall above.

itinerary.title: Kala Patthar, descend to Pheriche
itinerary.description: A pre-dawn climb of Kala Patthar (5,545m) for the finest close view of Everest, then a long drop to thicker air.

itinerary.title: Pheriche to Namche
itinerary.description: Retrace the valley with new eyes — the mountains always look different on the way down.

itinerary.title: Namche to Lukla
itinerary.description: One last crossing of the high bridges and a farewell dinner with your crew.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Morning flight out of the mountains and a hot shower that will feel better than any in your life.

name: Manaslu Circuit
summary: The great circuit around the world's eighth highest mountain — a restricted-area trail through Tibetan-influenced villages, culminating in the long, unforgettable crossing of the Larkya La.
highlights: Cross the Larkya La pass (5,106m) at dawn
Tibetan Buddhist culture in Samagaon and Samdo
Pungyen Gompa beneath Manaslu's south face
A fraction of the crowds of the Annapurna or Everest trails

itinerary.title: Drive to Machha Khola
itinerary.description: A long, scenic drive from Kathmandu along the Budhi Gandaki river to the trailhead.

itinerary.title: Machha Khola to Jagat
itinerary.description: Enter the restricted Manaslu Conservation Area, following the gorge past waterfalls and hot springs.

itinerary.title: Jagat to Deng
itinerary.description: The valley narrows and the culture shifts — mani walls and prayer wheels mark the way.

itinerary.title: Deng to Namrung
itinerary.description: Climb through fir forest as the first views of Manaslu appear up the valley.

itinerary.title: Namrung to Samagaon
itinerary.description: Pass Lho's ribbon monastery and walk straight into the amphitheater of Manaslu's east face.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Samagaon
itinerary.description: Hike toward Pungyen Gompa or Manaslu Base Camp, then rest in one of the Khumbu's most beautiful villages.

itinerary.title: Samagaon to Samdo
itinerary.description: A short walk to the last village before the pass, a Tibetan refugee settlement of yak herders.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Samdo
itinerary.description: Day hike toward the Tibetan border for big views and better acclimatization.

itinerary.title: Samdo to Dharamsala
itinerary.description: Climb to the stone shelters of Larkya Phedi beneath the glacier. Early night — tomorrow is the big one.

itinerary.title: Cross the Larkya La to Bimthang
itinerary.description: Start before dawn for the long climb to the prayer-flagged pass (5,106m), with Himlung, Cheo and Annapurna II spread before you — then descend to green Bimthang.

itinerary.title: Bimthang to Tilije
itinerary.description: Drop through rhododendron and pine back into the world of trees and warmth.

itinerary.title: Tilije to Dharapani, drive to Besisahar
itinerary.description: Join the Annapurna Circuit trail briefly, then jeep down the Marsyangdi valley.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return to the capital with legs that have circled an eight-thousander.

name: Kanchenjunga Base Camps
summary: Nepal's great eastern odyssey — a long, quiet journey to both base camps of the world's third highest mountain, through Limbu villages, cardamom fields and high yak pasture that sees a handful of trekkers a year.
highlights: Both North (Pangpema) and South (Oktang) base camps in one journey
Kanchenjunga (8,586m) — five treasures of the great snow
The remote Sele La crossing between the two valleys
Limbu and Rai culture in Nepal's far east
Genuinely empty trails — true expedition atmosphere

itinerary.title: Fly to Bhadrapur, drive to Ilam
itinerary.description: Fly to the Terai and drive up into the tea gardens of Ilam.

itinerary.title: Drive to Taplejung and Sekathum
itinerary.description: A rough, spectacular mountain road carries you deep into Kanchenjunga country.

itinerary.title: Sekathum to Amjilosa
itinerary.description: Enter the Ghunsa Khola gorge — a dramatic day of waterfalls, cliffs and suspension bridges.

itinerary.title: Amjilosa to Gyabla
itinerary.description: Climb out of the gorge into dense bamboo and rhododendron forest.

itinerary.title: Gyabla to Ghunsa
itinerary.description: Arrive in the great Tibetan-style village of Ghunsa, gateway to the upper valley.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Ghunsa
itinerary.description: Rest, explore the village monastery, and hike the ridge above town.

itinerary.title: Ghunsa to Khambachen
itinerary.description: Walk the flood-scoured valley beneath the massive north face of Jannu.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Khambachen
itinerary.description: Climb toward the Jannu viewpoint (4,400m) — one of the finest mountain vistas in Nepal.

itinerary.title: Khambachen to Lhonak
itinerary.description: Cross the wide, empty Lhonak plain, grazing ground of blue sheep and snow leopards.

itinerary.title: Pangpema — North Base Camp
itinerary.description: Reach Pangpema (5,143m) and stand before the towering north face of Kanchenjunga, then return to Lhonak.

itinerary.title: Lhonak to Ghunsa
itinerary.description: Descend the whole upper valley back to the comforts of Ghunsa.

itinerary.title: Ghunsa to Sele Le camp
itinerary.description: Climb steeply out of the valley to the high camp before the pass crossings.

itinerary.title: Cross the Sele La passes to Tseram
itinerary.description: A huge day over prayer-flagged cols (up to 4,480m) with Kanchenjunga, Jannu and Makalu on the horizon.

itinerary.title: Oktang — South Base Camp
itinerary.description: Walk up the Yalung glacier to Oktang (4,740m) beneath the sheer south face, then return to Tseram.

itinerary.title: Tseram to Tortong
itinerary.description: Descend through rhododendron forest into the Simbua Khola valley.

itinerary.title: Tortong to Yamphudin
itinerary.description: Over the Lasiya Bhanjyang and down to the first permanent village in days.

itinerary.title: Yamphudin to Khebang
itinerary.description: Gentle walking through Limbu farmland and cardamom groves.

itinerary.title: Drive to Bhadrapur
itinerary.description: The long road back to the lowlands — cold drinks and warm air.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Fly back to the capital along the Himalayan wall you just walked beneath.

name: Langtang Valley
summary: The valley of glaciers — a week-long walk from subtropical forest to a wide alpine bowl ringed by 7,000m peaks, home to Tamang villages, yak cheese factories and some of Nepal's warmest teahouses.
highlights: Summit Tserko Ri (4,984m) for a 360° Himalayan panorama
Kyanjin Gompa and its famous yak cheese factory
Tamang heritage along the old trade route to Tibet
Nepal's first Himalayan national park

itinerary.title: Drive to Syabrubesi
itinerary.description: Wind up the Trishuli valley to the trailhead at the Langtang river.

itinerary.title: Syabrubesi to Lama Hotel
itinerary.description: Climb through oak and bamboo forest — keep an eye out for red pandas and langur monkeys.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel to Langtang village
itinerary.description: The forest opens into the glacial valley; pass mani walls and water-driven prayer wheels.

itinerary.title: Langtang to Kyanjin Gompa
itinerary.description: A short, spectacular morning beneath Langtang Lirung to the valley's highest village.

itinerary.title: Summit Tserko Ri
itinerary.description: A dawn ascent of Tserko Ri (4,984m) — Langtang Lirung, Dorje Lakpa and Shishapangma in Tibet fill the horizon.

itinerary.title: Kyanjin to Lama Hotel
itinerary.description: A long, easy descent back into the forest.

itinerary.title: Lama Hotel to Syabrubesi
itinerary.description: Final walk down the valley and a farewell evening with your crew.

itinerary.title: Drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return to the capital by jeep.

name: Gosaikunda & the Laurebina La
summary: A short, steep pilgrimage to the sacred alpine lakes of Gosaikunda — where Shiva is said to have struck his trident into the rock — then over the Laurebina La into the ridge villages of Helambu.
highlights: The sacred blue lakes of Gosaikunda (4,380m)
Cross the Laurebina La (4,610m) with views from Manaslu to Langtang
Janai Purnima festival in August — thousands of pilgrims at the lake
Sunrises over the Helambu ridgeline

itinerary.title: Drive to Dhunche
itinerary.description: Leave Kathmandu after breakfast and climb to the park headquarters town of Dhunche.

itinerary.title: Dhunche to Sing Gompa
itinerary.description: A steep, beautiful climb through oak and rhododendron to the little monastery and cheese factory.

itinerary.title: Sing Gompa to Gosaikunda
itinerary.description: Break above the treeline onto a ridge of stone and sky; the first sacred lakes appear at Saraswati Kunda.

itinerary.title: Cross the Laurebina La to Ghopte
itinerary.description: Dawn around the lakes, then over the pass (4,610m) and a long, knee-testing descent to Ghopte.

itinerary.title: Ghopte to Kutumsang
itinerary.description: Ridge walking through cloud forest with windows onto the whole Langtang range.

itinerary.title: Kutumsang to Chisapani
itinerary.description: Through Sherpa and Tamang villages to Chisapani — 'cold water' — with its famous sunset view.

itinerary.title: Chisapani to Sundarijal, drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: A gentle morning through Shivapuri National Park, then a short drive back to the city.

name: Upper Dolpo
summary: The hidden land behind the Dhaulagiri wall — a three-week camping expedition across 5,000m passes to turquoise Phoksundo Lake, the ancient monastery of Shey, and villages where pre-Buddhist Bon culture still lives. Nepal as it was a century ago.
highlights: Phoksundo Lake — impossible turquoise beneath a 2,000m wall
Shey Gompa and the pilgrimage circuit of Crystal Mountain
Cross the Kang La (5,360m) and Jeng La (5,110m)
Bon and Tibetan Buddhist culture in Saldang and Dho Tarap
True wilderness camping — no teahouses, no crowds

itinerary.title: Fly to Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Fly southwest to the steamy Terai city, staging point for Dolpo.

itinerary.title: Fly to Juphal, trek to Dunai
itinerary.description: One of Nepal's great mountain flights, then walk down to the district capital on the Thuli Bheri.

itinerary.title: Dunai to Chhepka
itinerary.description: Follow the Suli Gad through walnut groves and riverside forest.

itinerary.title: Chhepka to Chunuwar
itinerary.description: Pass the Amchi traditional medicine hospital where Himalayan healers still train.

itinerary.title: Chunuwar to Phoksundo Lake
itinerary.description: Climb the ridge beside Nepal's highest waterfall, then the lake appears — a color you won't believe is real.

itinerary.title: Rest at Phoksundo
itinerary.description: Explore Ringmo village and the lakeside Bon monastery of Tshowa.

itinerary.title: Phoksundo to Sallaghari
itinerary.description: Walk the legendary cliff trail cut into the rock above the lake's western shore.

itinerary.title: Sallaghari to Kang La base camp
itinerary.description: Climb into the high glacial valley beneath the pass.

itinerary.title: Cross the Kang La to Shey Gompa
itinerary.description: Over the Kang La (5,360m) with Dhaulagiri and the Tibetan plateau behind you, down to the 'Crystal Monastery'.

itinerary.title: Rest at Shey Gompa
itinerary.description: Join pilgrims circling Crystal Mountain — the holiest peak in Dolpo.

itinerary.title: Shey to Saldang
itinerary.description: Cross the Saldang La to Dolpo's largest village, strung along a ridge above golden barley fields.

itinerary.title: Explore Saldang
itinerary.description: Visit Yangjer Gompa, the richest monastery in the region, and take tea with village families.

itinerary.title: Saldang to Namgung
itinerary.description: Walk the high trail past hermitage caves to the tiny settlement of Namgung.

itinerary.title: Cross the Jeng La to Dho Tarap
itinerary.description: Your second 5,000m pass (5,110m), descending into the fabled Tarap valley.

itinerary.title: Rest in Dho Tarap
itinerary.description: A full day among the chortens, monasteries and barley fields of one of Earth's highest permanent settlements.

itinerary.title: Dho Tarap to Tarap Khola gorge
itinerary.description: Descend into one of the Himalaya's most dramatic gorges, camp on a ledge above the river.

itinerary.title: Gorge to Khanigaon
itinerary.description: Canyon walls give way to forest as you lose altitude fast.

itinerary.title: Khanigaon to Tarakot
itinerary.description: Reach the old fortress town that once taxed the salt caravans from Tibet.

itinerary.title: Tarakot to Dunai
itinerary.description: Follow the Thuli Bheri back to Dunai's airstrip-side lodges.

itinerary.title: Dunai to Juphal
itinerary.description: A short climb to the airstrip and a final camp above the clouds.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu via Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Two flights and a world away — back to Kathmandu.

name: Lower Dolpo
summary: The compact Dolpo expedition — two weeks across the Numa La and Baga La to the mythic Tarap valley and the shores of Phoksundo, in the rain-shadow behind Dhaulagiri where monsoon never arrives.
highlights: Cross the Numa La (5,190m) and Baga La (5,070m)
Phoksundo Lake and Nepal's highest waterfall
Dho Tarap — one of the highest permanent settlements on Earth
Rain-shadow trekking: good weather when the rest of Nepal is in monsoon

itinerary.title: Fly to Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Fly to the Terai and prepare for the mountains.

itinerary.title: Fly to Juphal, trek to Dunai
itinerary.description: The spectacular short flight to Juphal, then down to the Thuli Bheri river.

itinerary.title: Dunai to Tarakot
itinerary.description: Walk upstream to the medieval fortress village of Tarakot.

itinerary.title: Tarakot to Laini
itinerary.description: Enter the Tarap gorge, camping by the river beneath towering cliffs.

itinerary.title: Laini to Nawarpani
itinerary.description: A tougher day of ascents on trails cut into the rock.

itinerary.title: Nawarpani to Dho Tarap
itinerary.description: The gorge opens suddenly into the wide, golden Tarap valley.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization in Dho Tarap
itinerary.description: Rest among the monasteries and mani walls; visit Bon and Buddhist gompas.

itinerary.title: Dho Tarap to Numa La base camp
itinerary.description: A short climb to the meadow camp beneath tomorrow's pass.

itinerary.title: Cross the Numa La to Pelung Tang
itinerary.description: Over the Numa La (5,190m) — Dhaulagiri's white wall fills the southern sky.

itinerary.title: Cross the Baga La to Dajok Tang
itinerary.description: A second 5,000m pass (5,070m) with views into the Phoksundo basin.

itinerary.title: Dajok Tang to Phoksundo Lake
itinerary.description: Descend through pine forest to the turquoise shore and Ringmo village.

itinerary.title: Rest at Phoksundo
itinerary.description: A day beside the lake — walk the shoreline, visit the gompa, breathe.

itinerary.title: Phoksundo to Chhepka
itinerary.description: Down past the great waterfall into the forests of the Suli Gad.

itinerary.title: Chhepka to Juphal
itinerary.description: Final walk to the airstrip and celebration with the crew.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu via Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Return to the capital.

name: Limi Valley
summary: The far northwest — a loop from Simikot to the Tibetan border and through Limi's thousand-year-old villages, where snow leopards outnumber trekkers and the Rinchenling monastery has stood since the 11th century.
highlights: Halji's Rinchenling Gompa — among Nepal's oldest monasteries
Follow the Karnali, Nepal's longest river, to its source at Tibet
Cross the Nara La (4,620m) and Nyalu La (4,940m)
Kermi's natural hot springs
Snow leopard, blue sheep and wolf country

itinerary.title: Fly to Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Fly to the western Terai.

itinerary.title: Fly to Simikot, trek to Dharapuri
itinerary.description: Land on Humla's ridge-top airstrip and begin walking through pine forest.

itinerary.title: Dharapuri to Kermi
itinerary.description: Follow the Karnali gorge to Kermi — soak in the hot springs beside the river.

itinerary.title: Kermi to Yalbang
itinerary.description: Pass barley fields to Yalbang's great Namkha Khyung Dzong monastery.

itinerary.title: Yalbang to Tumkot
itinerary.description: The trail climbs above the river into drier, Tibetan-feeling country.

itinerary.title: Tumkot to Yari
itinerary.description: A short climb to the last village before the pass, beneath the Himalaya's western ramparts.

itinerary.title: Cross the Nara La to Hilsa
itinerary.description: Over the Nara La (4,620m) and down to Hilsa on the Tibetan border, the Karnali roaring through a cleft in the rock.

itinerary.title: Hilsa to Manepeme
itinerary.description: Turn east into the Limi valley along the ancient salt-trade route.

itinerary.title: Manepeme to Til
itinerary.description: Reach Til, Limi's first village — stone houses, barley fields and glacier views.

itinerary.title: Til to Halji
itinerary.description: Walk to Halji and the 11th-century Rinchenling Gompa, still lit by butter lamps.

itinerary.title: Halji to Jang
itinerary.description: Continue to Jang, the highest and remotest of Limi's three villages.

itinerary.title: Rest in the Limi valley
itinerary.description: Explore the valley — hot springs above Til, hermit caves, and villages unchanged for centuries.

itinerary.title: Jang to Talung
itinerary.description: Climb to the last camp before the Nyalu La, in true wilderness.

itinerary.title: Cross the Nyalu La to Selima Tsho
itinerary.description: The trek's highest point (4,940m) — a panorama from Api and Saipal to the Tibetan plateau — then camp by the sacred lake.

itinerary.title: Selima Tsho to Kermi
itinerary.description: A long descent back to the Karnali — and another soak in the hot springs.

itinerary.title: Kermi to Simikot
itinerary.description: Climb back to Simikot for a farewell night above the clouds.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kathmandu via Nepalgunj
itinerary.description: Return to the capital from the far edge of Nepal.

name: Test Trek E2E
summary: Temporary live-site E2E test trek to verify the admin upload and CRUD flow.
highlights: E2E highlight one
E2E highlight two
